Implement usage-ledger.mjs exporting createLedger(), ingest(state,event), report(state,rates). State must survive JSON.stringify/parse and ingest mutates it in place. An event has id (globally unique nonempty string), stream (nonempty string identifying ONE model/provider/session), model (nonempty string), seq (nonnegative safe integer), kind ('delta' or 'cumulative'), input (inclusive of cached input), cachedInput, output (all nonnegative safe integers; cachedInput<=input). All usage fields required; unknown is not zero. A stream keeps one model and kind. Exact replays of an id must be no-ops even after restart; conflicting reuse throws without changing state. Reject out-of-order or repeated seq with a new id. Cumulative counters must never decrease individually; count only latest cumulative totals, rather than summing snapshots. Delta events sum. Validate safe-integer arithmetic and guarantee atomic ingestion: every rejection leaves state byte-for-byte unchanged. createLedger produces empty state. report returns {complete,totalUsd,byModel}; byModel[model] contains {uncachedInput,cacheRead,output}. rates[model] has uncachedInput,cacheRead,output USD per million, each finite and nonnegative. Sum all streams of the same model. Missing/invalid rates for an actually used model produce complete:false,totalUsd:null while preserving token totals. Empty ledger reports complete:true,totalUsd:0,byModel:{}. Do not round internal cost.

Implement budget.mjs exporting createBudget(limit), reserve(state,id,amount), settle(state,id,actual), release(state,id), snapshot(state). All amounts are integer micro-dollars (safe nonnegative integers); id is a nonempty string. Functions mutate a JSON-serializable state. snapshot returns {limit,spent,reserved,available,overdrawn}. Reserve holds a maximum estimate before a remote call; active holds reduce available. A repeated reserve with same id+amount is an idempotent replay regardless of whether later settled/released; changed amount or reuse for a different operation throws. A new reserve exceeding available throws. settle records actual spend, frees its hold, and is idempotent only for exactly the same actual amount; actual may exceed the reservation and even total limit because remote charges cannot be undone: record the full actual spend, set available=max(0,limit-spent-reserved), and overdrawn=true iff spent+reserved>limit. When overdrawn, reject every new reservation, including a zero-value reservation. release is only for a remote call known not to have run, frees an active hold, and repeats idempotently; it rejects an already settled id. settle rejects a released or unknown id. Never infer release from a timeout; an unresolved reservation survives JSON serialization and continues blocking spend after restart. Reject invalid input or unsafe arithmetic without changing state. Snapshot must not expose mutable internals. No filesystem or network needed in this module.
